raw.query: SELECT resolution, model, count(*) AS wins, count(*) FILTER (WHERE mode = 'cov') AS cov_wins FROM provenance.v_forecast_best GROUP BY resolution, model ORDER BY CASE resolution WHEN '1s' THEN 1 WHEN '15s' THEN 2 WHEN '30s' THEN 3 WHEN '45s' THEN 4 WHEN '1min' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, wins DESC;
raw.observed: Each resolution has 8 cells. Toto wins 8/8 at 1s, 8/8 at 15s, 7/8 at 30s. At coarse 1min, Toto-2 wins 3/8 cells (37.5%), Chronos-2 wins 2/8 (25.0%), EWMA wins 2/8 (25.0%), and TimesFM wins 1/8 (12.5%).
raw.claimed: Toto-2 (usually with covariates) takes the fine-bin cells and Chronos-2 most of the coarse ones
raw.evidence: Toto-2 dominates fine resolutions but Chronos-2 wins only 2/8 coarse cells (25.0%), fewer than Toto-2's 3 wins (37.5%) and tied with EWMA.
raw.fix: Replace with: 'Toto-2 (usually with covariates) takes nearly all fine-bin cells (23 of 24), while at the coarse 1min resolution, Toto-2 still leads with 3 wins, and Chronos-2 wins only 2 of 8 cells.'
